rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Having considered the candidacy submitted by the President, the State Duma, under Article 103(1)(a), gives the President consent to appoint Fradkov Mikhail Efimovich Chairman of the Government; in force on adoption; signed by Б.В.Грызлов, Moscow, 12 May 2004, No. 489-IV GD.
